claims.text: When a hazard occurs, try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft, and if possible, reestablish the link.

claims.text: If the connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

claims.text: Transfer of operational control between certificated remote pilots is allowed only if both can maintain Visual Line of Sight without loss of control.
claims.quote: Two or more certificated remote pilots transferring operational control (i.e., the remote PIC designation) to each other may do so only if they are both capable of maintaining Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) of the small unmanned aircraft without loss of control (LOC).
conditions: Transfer of control between remote pilots

text: FAA guidance says attempt to reestablish the control link and, if impossible, begin emergency/contingency procedures; preflight briefings must include control link loss procedures. Autel EVO Max 4N manuals indicate the drone will try to reconnect after signal loss, will alert on C2 loss, may continue automated flight to a disconnection, and will perform a Signal Loss Action if the C2 link is out for more than 10 seconds. Incident reports (unverified) describe complete loss with failed RTH and the aircraft continuing to drift away with no location. Gaps: this conflicts with the manual’s emphasis on reconnection, and missing standardized transfer/losss procedures and detailed post-loss steps.
